about.title: About Fazlaka
about.intro: Fazlaka is a streaming platform for movies, series, and seasons — built for Arabic-speaking audiences, bringing browsing, watching, and social features together in one place.

mission.p: We believe great stories deserve a home. Fazlaka brings together a library of films and shows with a community where you can rate, review, share playlists, and talk with friends.

features.p: Browse seasons and episodes, build playlists, follow your favorites, rate and review content, message friends, and get one-tap support through chat or a voice call.

social.p: Comment, like, and share. Send friend requests, chat in private conversations, and share your watch history with the people you trust.

privacy.p: We are committed to protecting your data. Read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service to understand how we handle your information.

contact.p: Questions or feedback? Open a support ticket or email us at support@fazlaka.app.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of Fazlaka (the "Service"). By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms.
terms.usernameHint: Your username is public and can be changed later in settings.
terms.summary: By accepting, you confirm that you have read and agree to our

acceptance.p: By creating an account or using Fazlaka, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

account.p: You are responsible for safeguarding your account credentials and for all activity that happens under your account. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized use of your account.

content.p: You retain ownership of the content you submit. By posting content, you grant Fazlaka a limited, non-exclusive license to host and display it so that we can provide the Service.

conduct.p: Do not misuse the Service: no spam, harassment, impersonation, copyright infringement, or attempts to disrupt the platform or harm other users.

ip.p: Fazlaka's name, logo, and interface are the property of Fazlaka. You may not copy or reuse them without our written permission.

termination.p: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms. You may stop using Fazlaka at any time and delete your account from your settings.

liability.p: Fazlaka is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.

contact.p: Questions about these Terms? Contact us at support@fazlaka.app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using Fazlaka, you agree to the practices described here.

data.p: We collect account details (name, email, username), profile content you add, watch history and preferences, device and technical information, and support communications.

use.p: We use your information to provide the Service, personalize recommendations, send important notifications, improve the platform, and keep it safe.

sharing.p: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with service providers (hosting, email, analytics) that help us operate the Service, and when required by law.

cookies.p: We use essential cookies for authentication and preferences. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

retention.p: We keep your data for as long as your account is active and delete or anonymize it when you close your account, subject to legal requirements.

rights.p: You can access, correct, or delete your personal data from your account settings, or contact us to exercise your privacy rights.

contact.p: Privacy questions? Contact us at support@fazlaka.app.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Quick answers to common questions about Fazlaka. Can't find what you need? Open the Support page and create a ticket.

account.q: How do I create an account?
account.a: Open the register page, complete the three steps (name, security details, and review), accept the terms, and submit.

password.q: How do I reset my password?
password.a: On the login page tap "Forgot password", enter your email, and use the code we send to choose a new password.

free.a: Fazlaka is free to browse and to create an account. Paid plans and features may be added in the future.

support.a: Open the Support page, create a ticket, and chat or call the support team directly.

delete.a: Yes. Go to Settings → Profile and follow the delete-account flow. Your data is handled according to our Privacy Policy.

loginEmail.q: Why did I receive a sign-in email?
loginEmail.a: We send a security email whenever a login happens from a new location or device. If it wasn't you, change your password immediately.

twofactor.q: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
twofactor.a: Go to Settings → Security and enable two-factor authentication using an email code or an authenticator app.

referral.q: How does the referral program work?
referral.a: Share your referral code with friends. When they sign up, you earn the rewards described in the program.
